verdict: Maybe, for a team with eye-care partners. Cure See pitched AI-based vision therapy on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Conditions such as lazy eye affect many children, and game-based therapy can help, but you need ophthalmologists to prescribe and supervise it.
angle: Vision therapy for conditions such as amblyopia traditionally needs many clinic visits. Game-based software can deliver exercises at home. Eye doctors are the key channel, and clinical evidence drives adoption.
